name: arxa-personalisation
description: Settings > Personalisation tab (0.1.0, user request): the Background group had outgrown General, so every look-and-feel row now lives in a dedicated 4th settings section (nav order 18, between Plugins 15 and Agent presets 20). The section declares and renders the child slot settings.personalisation.item; the row owners retarget their registrations there — Accent + Editor font (arxa-theme-accent, orders 0/10) and the whole Background group (arxa-prism, order 20). General keeps behavior rows (Enter behavior, Browser session, Pair a device). The section chrome mirrors the General section's (flex column + last-row border removal); the nav icon for the new tab is a palette glyph swapped in via pure CSS (the settings shell's navIcon() hardcodes icons by section id and a new id would fall back to a second gear). Pure client side; the host half is a no-op stub so the composition row has a plugin to load.
